coverage.formula: coverage = measured / (measured + offBookEst); offBookEst = suppressedChecks + excusedElements × 12 (GROUP_CHECKS sum = checks per fully-measured element; conservative — the 5 unskippable per-element checks are not counted). Section cells only; scroll/interact extensions are not coverage-scored.

thresholds.offBookCap: 70% (FAIL(off-book) unless reviewed in coverage-review.json with written reason + owner task)

gateFailures.threshold: < 40% measured (coverage floor — no escape; lift it with section work)
≥ 70% off-book (excused×12+skipped est.) — escape only via a written review in coverage-review.json
≥ 50% heuristic-paired — explicit data-spec binding is achievable (intro/usecase ≈0.8%)
< 40% measured (coverage floor — no escape; lift it with section work)
≥ 70% off-book (excused×12+skipped est.) — escape only via a written review in coverage-review.json

edge390.tolerance: ±2px vs the spec's recorded 390 section-root gutter
